title: Stop Saying "Very Big"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very big". Try one of these instead:
• huge: a huge pumpkin
• giant: a giant pumpkin
• enormous: an enormous mountain
• massive: a massive rock
• vast: a vast field

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.

Find more words for big on anotherwordfor.net
